name: Brojek Sky Beat 4 Pirates
summary:
Ahoy! Brojek Sky Beat 4 Pirates is a pirate rhythm game in VR.

Every round starts on a pirate drum kit made of barrels and brass cymbals. Then the drums sink away, your sticks turn into two cutlasses and a wooden conveyor brings everything to the beat: treasure chests full of coins, long crates you rip open, chains, cannonballs, barrels, ropes, bottles, maps and gems.

- Drums, swords and fists: play the drums, slice to the beat, then punch down 5 meter brick walls with steel fists
- Cut pirates, the arms
